title: volumes: propagate error from MountCount in VolumeMounted
body:
### Summary
Fixes an issue in `pkg/domain/infra/abi/volumes.go` where errors returned by `vol.MountCount()` were suppressed with `//nolint: nilerr`, causing `VolumeMounted()` to falsely report a volume as unmounted (`false`) when an error occurred.

### Context & Rationale
Previously, if `vol.MountCount()` failed (e.g., due to storage corruption, driver lookup failure, or plugin unreachability), the error was ignored and swallowed with a `FIXME` comment. While returning `false` served as a fallback, it hid underlying volume state issues from CLI and API clients.

This PR removes the `nolint` directive and returns `nil, err` when `MountCount()` fails so that potential volume state errors can be surfaced to the caller.

### Changes Included
- Updated `ic.VolumeMounted()` in `pkg/domain/infra/abi/volumes.go` to return `nil, err` if `vol.MountCount()` returns an error.
- Removed outdated `// FIXME` comment and `//nolint: nilerr` directive.


Signed-off-by: prayag0one4 <prayag0one4@users.noreply.github.com>
